newsitem.title: UK: Elf to start Rockall Trough seismic surveys soon.
newsitem.headline: Elf to start Rockall Trough seismic surveys soon.

text.p: French oil company Elf Acquitaine said on Tuesday it would begin surveying the deep waters west of Ireland this summer after winning the right to operate eight blocks earlier this month.
"Seismic work is planned to start this summer," the company said in a statement.
Elf Petroleum Ireland BV will be operator with a 50 percent stake on eight blocks in two separate groups and is a partner with a 50 percent stake on a third group of four blocks.
Eleven exploration licenses covering 58 full and partial blocks in the Rockall Trough, where water depths exceed 1,500 metres, were awareded on June 4 by the Department of Energy in Dublin.

Elf was also successful in Britain's 17th licensing round awarded in April, winning the right to operate six blocks with a share of 30 percent in water depths of about 1,000 metres at the northern end of the Rockall Trough west of the Hebrides Islands.
